title: result.packet (v1)
description: An engine packet on the bus. Published by the bus `Messaging` adapter in the job's child Launcher (every `IMessagingHandler.Send(packet)`) and, for the final result, by the worker host after upload. Exchange `lean.events`, routing key `job.<kind>.<jobId>.<event>.v1` where `<event>` follows the packet type (topology.md). No engine type changes: an inline body IS the packet's existing Newtonsoft JSON (`JsonConvert.SerializeObject(packet)`, PascalCase), so consumers deserialize `BacktestResultPacket`, `LiveResultPacket`, `LogPacket`, `OrderEventPacket`, ... unchanged; AMQP type `packets.v1.<PacketType>`, header `packet-type`. A packet is sent by reference instead (AMQP type `packets.v1.PacketRef`) when it is the final result (always, ADR 0005) or its serialized body exceeds the 256 KiB inline limit.

InlinePacket.title: Inline LEAN packet
InlinePacket.description: A LEAN `QuantConnect.Packets.Packet` subclass serialized as-is. Only the fields consumers rely on are constrained; every other packet field passes through (additionalProperties).

Type.description: LEAN `PacketType` (StringEnumConverter). Other packet types are not published in v1.

Progress.description: Partial packets only: the final packet (Progress = 1) always goes by reference.

PacketRef.title: Packet by reference
PacketRef.description: Stand-in for a packet stored in MinIO. Never carries the payload.

final.description: true for the final result of the attempt.

object.description: Final: `lean-results/<jobId>/<attempt>/<algorithmId>.json`, the engine's own result file. Oversize partial: `lean-results/<jobId>/<attempt>/packets/<sequence>.json`, the packet JSON that would have been inline.

format.description: `lean-result-file`: camelCase result JSON written by `BaseResultsHandler.SaveResults` (deserialize as `BacktestResult`/`LiveResult` with the result handler's serializer settings). `lean-packet`: the PascalCase packet JSON of an InlinePacket.
